Subject: Order form / MSA: proposal for SOC 2 windows, pen-test notice, and evidence tempo — ask list

Sarah — thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, we want to close the MSA + Order Form quickly but need to align on three discrete items in the security exhibit so your procurement/legal team is comfortable:

1) SOC 2 evidence windows: healthconnect asked for quarterly artifact pulls vs our standard annual snapshot. Proposed compromise (attached sheet): a bounded quarterly snapshot for high-risk assertions only (Auth, Logging, Key mgmt) and annual roll-up for lower-risk items.
2) Pen-test notice and access window: HealthConnect requested 14-day notice + in-person inspection rights. We can commit to 7 business days notice with an ephemeral staging window and scoped pen-test-only access (no tenant-level credentials).
3) Evidence tempo / delivery format: we can provide a weekly ticketed evidence bucket during onboarding (S3 link or shared Drive) and then move to monthly bundles for production. See attached "evidence-tempo-proposal.xlsx" for mapping to SOC 2 assertions.

Action for you: please confirm whether the above compromise is acceptable, or flag the single non-starter so we can route to legal. If acceptable, we'll produce redlines to the Order Form and the exhibit tonight and route to Karthik for signoff.

Attachments: HC_OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf (annotated), evidence-tempo-proposal.xlsx (mapping)

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Order form / MSA: proposal for SOC 2 windows, pen-test notice, and evidence tempo — ask list

Ben — appreciate the clear summary. Quick replies from our side:

• Evidence windows: HealthConnect security operations is comfortable with a hybrid approach, but they need the quarterly fetches to include sampling of config change logs and a standing report of failed auth attempts. Can you make that explicit in the exhibit?
• Pen-test notice: 7 business days is workable. Two asks: (a) we need a single point of contact for on-call coordination during the window, and (b) we want a clause that any findings that affect PHI handling are escalated to our compliance lead within 48 hours.
• Evidence delivery: S3 link is fine; we prefer signed links (time-limited) for each bundle.

I'll run this with procurement today; if procurement is comfortable, we can accept the redline run you send over and expedite DocuSign routing.

Thanks — I'll confirm by EOD.

Team / Sarah — I reviewed the attached redlines and the proposed evidence tempo. High level comments from Legal:

- SOC 2 quarterly fetch: acceptable if scoped. We propose language to limit quarterly pulls to the listed assertions and to deny tenant-level forensic access unless mutually agreed in writing. I added a short clause recommending sampled artifact types (change logs, auth failures, key rotation logs).
- Pen-test notice and access: we can accept 7 business days notice. We will not agree to unspecified "in-person" inspection rights. Instead, propose: "penetration testing limited to a mutually agreed scope and performed against a customer-designated staging environment; access will be ephemeral and subject to standard red-team controls." Also, we will put an obligation on HealthConnect to provide a list of test IPs and a non-repudiation statement prior to any test.
- PHI escalation: we will agree to a 48-hour initial acknowledgement and an SLA for remediation coordination, but cannot unilaterally assume legal liability for third-party derived findings; suggest an escalation matrix instead.

I attached a marked-up exhibit with explicit language (HC_OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf). Next steps: Ben, if Sarah signs off to the approach, Laura can publish a clean Order Form for procurement and Monica will own the evidence delivery schedule operationally.

Karthik Iyer
Associate General Counsel | Redwood Inference

Agreed:
- 7 business day pen-test notice with scoped staging access and required test IP list. Redwood to provide single on-call liaison for the window (Monica will be primary).
- Evidence delivery via signed time-limited S3 links. Weekly onboarding buckets, then monthly for production.
- 48-hour acknowledgement for PHI-impacting findings with an escalation matrix (see attached).

Open / small asks from HealthConnect to confirm:
- Explicit inclusion of "change logs" and "auth failure reports" in quarterly fetches (we can add that to the exhibit).
- Procurement asked whether the quarterly fetches can be automated exports vs manual pulls — Monica, can we confirm whether we can commit to automated exports for the scoped items?
